hero.title: Passionate Sea People
hero.lede: The people who make every expedition what it is.
hero.imageAlt: A catamaran at anchor in a quiet bay at dusk

intro:
We select crew for two things: how they handle a boat, and how they make people feel welcome on it. Most charter companies hire for one or the other. We don't.

Read their profiles below, and tell us who you'd like on board. We'll do our best to match their schedule, though we can't always guarantee it.
